title: NBA Form I: Application for Access to Biological Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
raw_text:
Form I [See Rule 14 of Biological Diversity Rules, 2004]:
Application form for access to biological resources occurring in India and associated knowledge for the purpose of research or commercial utilization or bio-survey and bio-utilization.
Mandatory for all entities covered under Section 3(2) of the Act (non-citizens, NRIs, foreign companies, or Indian companies with any foreign shareholding/control).
Application Fee: ₹10,000.
Required Attachments: Identity of foreign collaborator, GPS source location, local community consultation proof.
guidance: Indian startups that take overseas funding (e.g. US/Singapore VC funds) become Section 3 entities under Companies Act definitions and MUST file Form I before purchasing or extracting Indian herbs.
